title: rt: avoid overflow in shutdown timeout
body:
## What

Fix Runtime::shutdown_timeout(Duration::MAX) panicking on Instant overflow.

## Why

shutdown_timeout adds the duration to Instant::now() with the panicking + operator. Duration::MAX can overflow before shutdown completes.

## Implementation

- Use Instant::checked_add.
- Treat an unrepresentable deadline as unbounded and park until shutdown finishes.
- Add regression coverage for current-thread and multi-thread runtimes.
